risks.title: Cybersecurity threats and data breaches
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned early in Item 1A with intensive language: 'could affect our business and information systems'. Cybersecurity category carries strong weight. Trend is stable but context of 'continually evolving cyber threats' indicates persistent and growing risk. Strategic positioning of risk within report structure confirms existential criticality for financial sector.

risks.title: Complex and evolving regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in overview with strong language: 'highly regulated, subject to extensive and evolving supervisory, consumer protection, privacy'. Regulatory category weight is strong. Trend is stable but 'evolving' indicates continuous increase. Central positioning in business description confirms existential impact on business model.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party vendors and integrations
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly identified in risk management program: 'cybersecurity threats related to third-party providers on which we rely'. Language is moderate but context is critical given multiple integrations and legacy systems. Trend is stable. Industrial category weight is medium-strong for financial sector.

risks.title: Competitive intensity and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: Risk is implicit in market description: 'rapidly growing demand', 'rise of FinTechs and Alt-FIs'. Language is moderate but context of rapid transformation indicates growing pressure. Trend is upward given new entrants and disruption. Competition category weight is medium.

risks.title: Key personnel and retention risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk is implicit in dependence on critical roles such as CRO and CISO with specialized long-standing experience. Language is neutral but organizational structure reveals concentration of responsibilities. Trend is stable. Key personnel category weight is medium.

risks.title: Significant investments before return realization
risks.score_rationale: Risk is explicit in MD&A: 'investments will occur in advance of any associated benefit'. Language is moderate but concept repetition indicates concern. Trend is stable. Capital category weight is medium for SaaS growth.

risks.title: Revenue concentration on digital banking platform
risks.score_rationale: Risk is implicit in revenue structure: 'continue to generate a substantial majority of our revenue from our digital banking platform'. Language is neutral but concentrated dependency indicates vulnerability. Trend is stable but diversification strategy is underway. Competition category weight is medium.

ai_positioning.summary: Q2 does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
